newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle sales to light for test-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle sales to light for test-USDA.

text.p: Trade quiet. No sales slaughter steers confirmed, not enough slaughter heifer sales confirmed for a market test.
Inquiry and demand light. Feedlots remained extremely current. Sales confirmed on 50 slaughter heifers Friday.
Sales confirmed this week on 74800 head including 21700 head or about 29 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter Heifers Short-load Select and Choice 2-3 1025 lbs 68.00.
